# Gertrude

> Gertrude is parental-control software for Apple devices, built by a Christian
> homeschool dad to give families strict, reliable internet-safety tools. The
> lineup covers Mac, iPhone/iPad, a PIN-gated podcast app for kids, and a
> parent-curated music app.

Gertrude was created by Jared Henderson to protect his own children before it
became a product. The Mac app is the flagship: a deny-by-default internet
filter paired with optional screenshot and keystroke monitoring, managed by
parents from a web dashboard. The iPhone/iPad app is a focused tool that plugs
holes in Apple's Screen Time — blocking `#images` GIF search in Messages,
Spotlight image search, Maps business-listing images, and similar loopholes.
Gertrude Podcasts is a podcast app that lets kids listen to parent-approved shows
while gating the ability to add new podcasts behind a PIN; it connects to a
Gertrude parent account for subscription and PIN management. Gertrude Music is
an Apple Music player with no open-ended browsing — kids can only play the
artists and albums a parent has approved from the dashboard.

## Products

- [Gertrude for Mac](https://gertrude.app/mac): Deny-by-default internet filter
  with optional screenshot and keystroke monitoring, downtime schedules, app
  blocking, and parent-approved unlock requests. Requires the Full plan
  ($10/month), which covers the whole family. 21-day free trial, no credit card
  required.
- [Gertrude Blocker for iPhone & iPad](https://gertrude.app/iphone-and-ipad):
  Free iOS content filter that closes known Screen Time gaps — Messages GIF
  search, Spotlight internet image search, Apple Maps imagery, App Store
  images, and similar surfaces. Optional parent-account connection lets you
  change which categories are blocked remotely. Apple restricts iOS content
  filtering to devices signed in to under-18 Apple Accounts by default; to
  use the Blocker on an adult-owned device, Gertrude offers a free companion
  supervision tool (Mac and Windows) that places a device into Apple
  Supervised Mode. See the [Supervised Mode setup
  guide](https://gertrude.app/help/iphone-ipad/use-blocker-over-18) for details.
- [Gertrude Podcasts](https://gertrude.app/#podcasts) (formerly Gertrude AM):
  A kid-friendly podcast app where adding new shows requires a parent-set 6-digit PIN.
  Connects to a Gertrude parent account; free to try for 30 days, then requires at
  least a Light plan ($10/year for the whole family) to keep adding and updating shows.
- [Gertrude Music](https://gertrude.app/music): A parent-managed Apple Music
  player for kids, with no open-ended browsing or search. Parents approve
  artists and albums from the Gertrude dashboard, and the child can only play
  from that approved library. Kids can build their own playlists, but playlist
  membership never grants permission to play music a parent hasn't approved.
  Connects to a Gertrude parent account; requires at least a Medium plan
  ($5/month for the whole family) and an active Apple Music subscription on the
  device.

## Plans

Gertrude uses one family account with four stacked plan tiers, each including
everything below it. Every paid plan covers the whole family, with no ads.

- **Free** — basic iOS blocking (GIF, Spotlight, and Maps loopholes) plus a
  30-day Gertrude Podcasts trial.
- **Light** ($10/year) — adds Gertrude Podcasts and iOS device supervision.
- **Medium** ($5/month) — adds Gertrude Music.
- **Full** ($10/month) — adds Gertrude for Mac. Includes a 21-day free trial.

## Guides

- [Gertrude Guides](https://gertrude.app/guides): Step-by-step guidance for protecting
  devices and making thoughtful internet-safety choices for your family.
- [Getting started with Gertrude for Mac](https://gertrude.app/guides/getting-started-with-gertrude-for-mac):
  A comprehensive tutorial covering account setup, Mac installation, notifications,
  filter suspensions, keychains, unlock requests, and activity review. Some instructions
  and screenshots are outdated while Gertrude prepares an update.
- [Tips for keeping users safe](https://gertrude.app/guides/keeping-kids-safe-online):
  Internet-safety guidance for parents covering passwords, monitoring, conversations,
  layered protections, friends’ devices, and Gertrude’s Internet Safety 101 video.
- [Unblocking websites and apps on a Mac](https://gertrude.app/guides/unblocking-websites-and-apps-on-mac):
  Understand Gertrude's keys and keychains, why websites need access to multiple domains,
  and how to isolate and request the supporting addresses a website or app needs.
- [Five overlooked iPhone lockdown loopholes](https://gertrude.app/guides/iphone-lockdown-loopholes):
  Older guidance about GIF search, Maps images, device search, Look Up, Siri, and household
  devices. A warning identifies instructions that need updating for current iOS versions.
- [Locking down an iPhone or iPad](https://gertrude.app/guides/locking-down-an-iphone):
  The canonical, continuously updated step-by-step walkthrough of Screen Time restrictions,
  common loopholes, and Gertrude Blocker for iPhone and iPad. Always covers the current iOS
  version. Version-specific archives for older iOS releases are linked from the version
  picker on the page.

## Updates

- [Gertrude Updates](https://gertrude.app/updates): Product announcements and release
  notes from Gertrude.
- [Introducing Gertrude Music](https://gertrude.app/updates/gertrude-music-launch):
  The launch announcement for Gertrude’s approved-only music app for iPhone and iPad,
  including its design, requirements, and family pricing.
- [Introducing Gertrude Podcasts](https://gertrude.app/updates/gertrude-podcasts-launch):
  The launch announcement for Gertrude’s kid-friendly podcast app, where a parent-set PIN
  controls which shows children can add.
- [Daily screenshot review reminders](https://gertrude.app/updates/daily-screenshot-review-reminders):
  Gertrude for Mac can send parents a daily email reminder when their kids have new,
  unreviewed screenshots.
- [Security event notifications](https://gertrude.app/updates/security-event-notifications):
  Gertrude for Mac can notify parents by email, text, or Slack about filter suspensions,
  password changes, login attempts, and other security events.
- [Flag child activity](https://gertrude.app/updates/flag-child-activity): Parents can flag
  screenshots and keystrokes so they remain available for review for up to 60 days.
- [Gertrude for Mac 2.5.0](https://gertrude.app/updates/gertrude-for-mac-2-5-0):
  Introduced scheduled keychains, Mac downtime, security events, a redesigned keychain
  picker, and the first version of Gertrude Blocker.
- [Gertrude for Mac 2.7.0](https://gertrude.app/updates/gertrude-for-mac-2-7-0):
  Introduced Mac app blocking, a monitoring safeguard, macOS Sequoia compatibility,
  keychain risk warnings, and more detailed filter status.
- [Gertrude for Mac 2.9.0](https://gertrude.app/updates/gertrude-for-mac-2-9-0):
  Introduced unfiltered mode, always-blocked items, batch unlock requests, more private
  screenshots, faster filtering, improved non-Safari support, and a rebuilt setup wizard.
- [Gertrude Blocker account connection](https://gertrude.app/updates/blocker-account-connection):
  Announced parent-account connection for remotely managing an iPhone or iPad’s block
  groups and receiving future connected-device features.
- [Gertrude Blocker 1.0 launch](https://gertrude.app/updates/gertrude-blocker-launch):
  Announced the first version of Gertrude for iPhone and iPad, focused on closing holes in
  Apple’s Screen Time controls.

## Help

- [Gertrude Help](https://gertrude.app/help): Browse support articles by device and app.
- [Mac help](https://gertrude.app/help/mac): Help with Gertrude’s Mac internet filter,
  monitoring, settings, and troubleshooting.
- [iPhone & iPad help](https://gertrude.app/help/iphone-ipad): Help with Gertrude Blocker
  on iPhone and iPad.
- [SOLVED: How to Block or Disable GIFs on iPhone](https://gertrude.app/help/iphone-ipad/block-gif-search-in-messages):
  Apple still won’t let parents turn off #images GIF search in Messages. Gertrude Blocker
  is a free iOS app that does and works on current iOS. The article preserves older setup
  instructions while a current version is prepared.
- [Block explicit images in Maps on iPhone or iPad](https://gertrude.app/help/iphone-ipad/block-explicit-images-in-maps):
  Older instructions for removing Maps apps that expose business photos; the article
  identifies that its instructions need updating for current iOS versions.
- [Block web content in device search](https://gertrude.app/help/iphone-ipad/block-web-content-in-device-search):
  Older Screen Time instructions for preventing iPhone and iPad search from displaying
  images and other internet content.
- [Block Look Up web results](https://gertrude.app/help/iphone-ipad/block-look-up-web-results):
  Older Screen Time instructions for preventing Look Up in reading and notes apps from
  displaying internet results.
- [Block Siri internet access](https://gertrude.app/help/iphone-ipad/block-siri-internet-access):
  Older Screen Time instructions for preventing Siri from displaying internet content.
- [Use Gertrude Blocker when the user is 18 or older](https://gertrude.app/help/iphone-ipad/use-blocker-over-18):
  Put an adult-owned iPhone or iPad into Apple Supervised Mode so Gertrude Blocker can use
  its content filter. The article is awaiting an update for Gertrude’s current Mac and
  Windows supervision tool.
- [Block album artwork in Apple Music on iPhone or iPad](https://gertrude.app/help/iphone-ipad/block-apple-music-artwork):
  Enable Gertrude Blocker’s Apple Music block group during setup or from a connected
  Gertrude parent account.
- [Fix a Screen Time conflict with Gertrude's Mac filter](https://gertrude.app/help/mac/screen-time-filter-conflict):
  Disable Screen Time's Content & Privacy restrictions and restart the Mac when Apple's
  web content filter conflicts with Gertrude's filtering.
- [Connect Gertrude Blocker to a parent account](https://gertrude.app/help/iphone-ipad/get-connection-code):
  Use the six-digit code and connection link shown in Gertrude Blocker to connect an
  iPhone or iPad, choose its child, and manage blocking from the parent website.
- [Run Gertrude's Mac health check](https://gertrude.app/help/mac/run-health-check): Find
  and fix common problems with the Mac filter, monitoring permissions, account, and
  settings.
- [Block Mac apps](https://gertrude.app/help/mac/block-apps): Block any macOS app for a
  child either all the time or on a schedule, and understand when app blocking adds useful
  protection beyond Gertrude's internet filter.
- [Can two kids share a Mac with different protections?](https://gertrude.app/help/mac/use-one-mac-for-multiple-children):
  Give each child a separate macOS user account and connect each user to their own
  Gertrude child profile and settings.
- [Decide whether to unblock YouTube](https://gertrude.app/help/mac/decide-whether-to-unblock-youtube):
  Keep YouTube blocked by default or use a temporary filter suspension for assigned
  videos, with optional screenshot review afterward.
- [Why browsers quit after a filter suspension](https://gertrude.app/help/mac/why-browsers-quit-after-filter-suspension):
  Understand why Gertrude closes browsers after temporary unrestricted access ends.
- [How to give a Mac admin user internet access](https://gertrude.app/help/mac/give-admin-user-internet-access):
  Exempt a password-protected Mac administrator account from Gertrude's internet filter.
- [Unblock a website or app on a Mac](https://gertrude.app/help/mac/unblock-website-or-app):
  Assign a public or personal keychain to allow a website, or grant an installed Mac app
  unrestricted internet access.
- [Why a website still looks broken after unblocking it](https://gertrude.app/help/mac/website-still-broken-after-unblocking):
  Learn why websites need access to multiple domains and how to allow their supporting
  images, code, video, sign-in, and other requests.
- [Diagnose blocked network requests on a Mac](https://gertrude.app/help/mac/diagnose-blocked-network-requests):
  Filter, clear, reproduce, and pause Gertrude's Blocked Requests list to isolate the
  domains preventing a website or app from working, then send an unlock request.
- [Send an unlock request on a Mac](https://gertrude.app/help/mac/send-unlock-request):
  Select blocked website or app requests in Gertrude for Mac and send them to a parent for
  review.
- [Restart Gertrude's Mac filter](https://gertrude.app/help/mac/restart-filter): Manually
  remove and restart the internet filter when it cannot communicate with the menu bar app.

## Legal

- [Terms of Service](https://gertrude.app/legal/terms): The terms and acceptable use
  policy governing Gertrude accounts, apps, and subscriptions.
- [Gertrude Blocker privacy policy](https://gertrude.app/legal/privacy/blocker): Privacy
  policy for the Gertrude Blocker iOS app. Gertrude collects no personal data
  from the iOS app — only anonymous error logs and install counts.
- [Gertrude Music privacy policy](https://gertrude.app/legal/privacy/music): Privacy
  policy for the Gertrude Music app and its parent-account connection.
- [Gertrude Podcasts privacy policy](https://gertrude.app/legal/privacy/podcasts): Privacy
  policy for the Gertrude Podcasts podcast app. The app sends a small amount of
  anonymous usage and diagnostic data to operate subscriptions, understand usage
  patterns, and fix bugs.

- [How Much of the Internet is Porn? A Detective Story](https://gertrude.app/blog/how-much-of-the-internet-is-porn):
  Research based on a randomized sample of reachable `.com` domains that estimated what
  proportion contained pornographic content.
- [Refer a friend](https://gertrude.app/refer-a-friend): Existing Gertrude customers can

  public-keychain requests.
- [Download the Mac app](https://gertrude.app/download-mac-app): Direct DMG
  download for the current Gertrude for Mac release.

## Parent dashboard

The parent dashboard is the web app at parents.gertrude.app where parents
manage children, connect Macs and iOS devices, review screenshots and typed
activity, approve unlock requests, and adjust monitoring settings. It is
auth-gated and not useful to crawl directly.

- [Sign up for a Gertrude account](https://parents.gertrude.app/signup): Create
  a parent account to start a 21-day Mac app trial or connect an iOS device.
- [Parent dashboard login](https://parents.gertrude.app/login): Sign in to an
  existing Gertrude account.

## About

Gertrude is built by Jared Henderson — a Christian, a homeschool dad, and a
computer programmer. The product is opinionated toward families who want
stricter controls than mainstream parental-control apps typically provide,
including Christian and homeschooling households. Gertrude for Mac uses an
allowlist model (block everything except what a parent has explicitly unlocked
via "keys" and "keychains") rather than the category-based blocklists most
competitors use.
